reason: I already have to show my partner the monthly spend and right now that means scrolling Telegram groups and guessing. If the free 40 documents turn my old site receipts into a clean sheet and a Monday report I can just forward, $19 or $45 a month is nothing next to one material order.
objection: A duplicate or a padded receipt is my foreman's problem, not something a bot fixes. And handwritten nota from building-supply shops are messy; if it misreads the totals I end up checking everything anyway and it is just another sheet nobody trusts.
would_change_my_mind: If on the free trial it misreads more than a couple of handwritten supplier nota or my partner says the report is useless, I cancel.
